title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E07 — Fleeing Hellmira
Timothy Vail and Timothy Morgan are murderers incarcerated at Elmira State Prison in Elmira, N.Y.; Vail wants to escape, so he engages Morgan in his plan to dig through the ceiling and flee from prison.

title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E06 — Belfast Breakout
HM Maze prison was a notorious lock-up for IRA prisoners in Northern Ireland; a small ring of IRA prisoners secretly planned what they hoped would be a massive prison break.

title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E05 — Escaping Hitler
The story of the escape of more than 70 men from Stalag Luft III, a German prisoner of war camp; only three eventually survived.

title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E04 — Conquering the Wall
Six men, led by the mastermind, Nuno Pontes, escaped Pittsburgh State Penitentiary by tunneling to freedom under the prison wall; they made it as far as Texas before being caught and returned to prison.

title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E03 — El Chapo
The most notorious and murderous drug cartel kingpins in modern history.

title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E02 — North Country Breakout
Stuck in prison on life sentences, two men used engineering smarts and psychological manipulation of several prison employees to escape Dannemora Prison; Richard Matt and David Sweat executed one of the most involved escapes from an American prison.

title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
description:
S01 E01 — Alcatraz
Four men conspire to break out of one of the most notorious prisons in American history; three of them break out using a makeshift raft and vanish.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

Magician and Houdini expert Bill Kalush secures access to Harry Houdini's diary previously kept from the public; experts begin to unveil the diary, using information gleaned from these personal accounts to form new insights into Houdini's life.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E06 — The Ark of the Covenant
A holy relic from the Bible has been missing for over 2,000 years; while some believe the Ark of the Covenant was destroyed, many people think it's still out there; new clues could finally explain what happened.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E01 — The Amber Room
One of World War II's greatest unsolved mysteries: an incomparable work of art worth half a billion dollars, lost without a trace; perhaps the single most valuable object the Nazis ever stole, the quest for this treasure has lasted over 75 years.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E05 — The Amityville Horror
After a series of dark and ominous events, an unassuming family home on Long Island becomes the most notorious house in America; 50 years later, it's spawned a title wave of books, documentaries, and films.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E05 — Captain Kidd's Treasure
In 1698, Capt. William Kidd raids a ship on the high seas and seizes its vast treasure, but Kidd is hanged before revealing where he stashed the loot; a look at what happened to the lost booty and where it is now.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E18 — Lost Civil War Gold
In the final days of the Civil War, Confederate leaders fled south, rumored to be carrying the Confederate treasury worth an estimated $13 million in today's money; when Jefferson Davis is captured, there's no treasure in his baggage.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

In ALONE's first-ever World Championship, ten new survivalists from across the globe are dropped into the remote and rugged Arctic Circle.

title: Alone

Ten new survivalists from across the globe are dropped into the remote and rugged Arctic Circle to battle for $500,000.

title: Alone

The survivalists grow comfortable in their surroundings, until the mountains signal a harsh shift ahead; as winter encroaches, one faces a dangerous predator encounter, while another begins to crack under the pressure.

title: Alone

S13 E05 — Thin Margins
As the survivalists find a brief window to regroup and refocus, the Arctic continues to test their resolve; one participant gets their chance at big game, while another faces a lynx who puts their food supply at risk.

title: Alone

S13 E06 — Balancing Act
With survival hinging on preparation, the remaining participants scramble to secure the essentials; key food wins offer a glimmer of hope, but mounting fatigue and a looming medical check threaten to unravel hard-earned progress.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E07 — Natural Order
Wildlife encounters push the participants to their limits as one faces a run-in with a moose and another is stalked by a bear; the environment continues to test both body and mind, forcing the competitors to confront external and internal threats.

title: Alone
description:

title: Alone

title: Alone
description:

Drug kingpins, serial killers, pirates, assassins, and murderous con men; criminals with bloody legacies.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E08 — Engineering Disasters
Cost-cutting moves to save on some of the Titanic's three million rivets; shortcuts taken while building a gladiator stadium in ancient Rome; how a little carelessness triggers deadly engineering failures in history.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E07 — Missions
From doomed voyages across continents and oceans to covert CIA operations, these missions show that no matter how much preparation and planning are done, things can still turn deadly.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames

From the Johnstown flood to the Indonesian tsunami, discover how water's power can transform into an unstoppable agent of death.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames

S01 E06 — Weapons
From ancient war machines to devastating weapons of mass destruction, these are the innovations that changed warfare and rank among history's deadliest.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E04 — Tyrants
From mad rulers like Caligula and Ivan the Terrible, to dictators like Mao Zedong and Saddam Hussein who killed by the millions, these are history's deadliest tyrants.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E02 — Explosions
One spark is all it takes; from the Hindenburg disaster to Krakatoa's violent volcanic eruption in 1883, these explosions are among history's deadliest.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E01 — Natural Disasters
From killer hurricanes and tsunamis to earthquakes, floods and fires, these are the deadliest natural disasters ever recorded.

title: Mysteries From Above

Revealing the truth behind the planet's ancient legends; touring an island covered in polar bears, twin craters in Greece, peeking at a supervolcano hidden under Yellowstone Park and examining an ocean formation that's eerily similar to Atlantis.
